shared_elements: relief figures carved on the face of an upright rectangular pillar/monolith
figures stacked one above another in a vertical column
creature/being rendered in relief with body parts (limbs, eyes) indicated
justification: The only real correspondence is structural rather than iconographic: both surfaces are upright pillar faces bearing relief figures placed one above another in a vertical sequence, which is a very general convention. What is depicted differs completely: A shows sparse, schematic quadrupeds in strict profile with wide empty ground around them, while B shows densely packed frontal anthropomorphic masks with headdresses smothered in curling scroll ornament leaving no blank surface at all.
